masteryZone.q: Which class claimed the highest social rank and intermediate status between gods and humans in the Later Vedic period?
masteryZone.sol: Brahmins claimed absolute socio-religious supremacy and ritual monopoly.

masteryZone.q: The Varna system of the Later Vedic Period was highly flexible and based strictly on individual merit rather than birth.
masteryZone.sol: The Later Vedic Varna system hardened into a rigid, hereditary, birth-based hierarchy.

masteryZone.q: The philosophical inquiries composed in Sanskrit that first questioned Vedic sacrifices were the ______.
masteryZone.sol: The Upanishads challenged sacrifices, comparing them to leaky boats.

masteryZone.q: Why was the doctrine of Ahimsa economic beneficial to the expanding agriculture in Gangetic valley?
opts: It prohibited farmers from paying taxes to kings
It preserved oxen and bulls from ritual sacrificial slaughter
It forced peasants to switch to dairy trade
It banned the import of foreign iron tools
masteryZone.sol: By prohibiting animal slaughter, Ahimsa preserved the cattle needed for plowing Gangetic fields.

masteryZone.q: The second urbanization of India in the 6th Century BCE was made possible by the introduction of iron plowshares and axes.
masteryZone.sol: Iron technology allowed deep tillage of hard clayey soil, creating agricultural surplus.

masteryZone.q: Match the economic phase with its key feature:
masteryZone.sol: Correct matches are: Second Urbanization - Gangetic Cities, Coins - Trade, Iron Plow - Tillage, Ahimsa - Cattle.

masteryZone.q: Which class provided the most significant financial and patron support to early Buddhism and Jainism?
masteryZone.sol: Vaishyas (merchants/Setthis) provided massive financial donations to gain social equality.

masteryZone.q: Siddhartha Gautama and Vardhamana Mahavira belonged to the priestly Brahmin class.
masteryZone.sol: Both were Kshatriya princes belonging to republican clans (Shakyas and Jnatrikas).

masteryZone.q: Which Varna was placed at the bottom-most rank and denied Upanishadic and Vedic study?
masteryZone.sol: Shudras were placed at the bottom and subjected to severe social disabilities.

masteryZone.q: Which languages were used primarily by Buddha and Mahavira respectively to preach to the masses?
masteryZone.sol: Buddha used Pali, and Mahavira used Prakrit/Ardhamagadhi.

masteryZone.q: Both Jainism and Buddhism rejected the intermediate role of priests and did not require costly sacrifices.
masteryZone.sol: They offered a direct, priest-less, ethical path focused on self-conduct.

masteryZone.q: Buddha's teaching of avoiding extreme luxury and extreme self-mortification is called the ______ Path.
masteryZone.sol: It is called the Middle Path (Madhyama Pratipada).
